titulo_infinito.configuration.title: MC:INFINITO: title logo
titulo_infinito.configuration.posicaoX.t: Moves the logo right (positive) or left (negative), in GUI pixels.
titulo_infinito.configuration.posicaoY.t: Moves the logo down (positive) or up (negative), in GUI pixels.
titulo_infinito.configuration.escala.too: 1.0 is the width of the original Minecraft logo. Grows from the top center.
titulo_infinito.configuration.animar.too: Makes the INFINITO rainbow flow and the stars twinkle.
titulo_infinito.configuration.segundosPo: How long the rainbow takes to go around once. Lower is faster.
